judging.title: Judging Process
judging.description: The competition review process takes place across four rounds. During each round, submitted posters are reviewed and either progress to the next stage or conclude their journey. Each round represents a different level of selection and feedback.

rounds.title: Round 1 (Accepted)
rounds.description: Your work has been viewed by the team, considered eligible, and successfully accepted into the poster contest.

afterSubmission.title: After Submission
afterSubmission.description: After submitting, you should receive a confirmation message or email. Please do not close or exit the page while your submission is uploading.

prize.question: What do I get if I win?
prize.answer: Winning entries receive recognition across our channels and programme materials, with selected works becoming part of the broader exhibition experience.
